_note: #1093 R1 + #1111 + #1092 + #1129 + #1114 + #1135 — set B, VERSIONED WITH THE RULES (11 files: top p1..p8, bottom p1..p3). vs tableVersion 1129-1: the bit change is now priced from the program before it and one pickAmongEquals decides every same-diameter tie (#1114), and a level pass no longer cuts where the cutter's disc reaches a CL above it (#1135's wall-foot guard). Programs: top 9 → 8 (the 3.175 flat's curved-rough program is gone; the ⌀1.5 × 6 flat takes the rough and the ⌀3.175 ball × 10 / ⌀1 × 4 ball finish), bottom 4 → 3 (the 0.9 flat's program and the 25 mm primary are gone: rough + pocket on the ⌀3.175 × 12, finish on the ⌀3.175 ball × 22, rest/pencil on the ⌀2 ball × 12). Goal verdicts: every program passes; no cell cut more than 0.1 mm into the goal; the bottom sentence reads 98.2 % within 0.01 mm (was 98.4 %; the wall-foot guard leaves a little more standing at the walls, and #1129's sampler floor moves the ball programs) with leftovers 0.9194 / 0.7211 / 0.4122 %, and the top reads 97.6 % (was 96.4 % at 1129-1; #1114's picks buy the extra coverage). The e2e reads this table as the cross-door check.
rule: #1114 (the maintainer's decision, 2026-11-09) + #1135 (the Manager's wall-foot ruling). (a) A BIT CHANGE IS PRICED FROM THE PROGRAM BEFORE IT: attendedChangeSeconds (rec. 120 s) while the preceding program is at most attendedMinutes (rec. 5); returnMinutes (rec. 15) on top from walkAwayMinutes (rec. 30) on; a smooth 3t² − 2t³ rise between; the sheet prints each change with its price and the preceding program. (b) PLANS COMPETE ON THE PRICED CYCLE; ties after price go the reach-margin gate (≥ reach.marginMm, rec. 1.0 mm) → the shortest sufficient flute → the larger diameter (the stiffer adequate tool) → the lower priced stage → the key — ONE pickAmongEquals at every site (the ball rank, the sequence primary, the curved flat, the rest ball). No 'pending #1114' rows remain; every same-diameter pick states its decider. (c) ORDERING IS PRICED WORK: the ball finish and the rim chamfer are offered in both orders (the freeing contour stays last). (d) A LEVEL PASS IS EMITTED ONLY WHERE THE CUTTER'S DISC CLEARS THE CL ABOVE IT (#1135): the rough's Z-levels and band skim and the skin all use one shared rule (`safeRasterRuns` / `splitUnsafeRuns`), so a wall-foot cell can no longer be cut by a pass meant for the floor beside it.
